fact: An INASA presentation dated 26 January 2019 states that monthly reports of health centres and hospitals are captured online in DHIS2 (gbsis.dhis2.org), that data entry was implemented in all 11 health regions in 2017, and that in 2018 a Real Time Monitoring pilot began entering data on tablets directly from the health areas, with expansion to all health areas still a recommendation.
title: Sistema de Informação de Saude
